Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and for sending the agenda — looks good. Quick update from our side: the CFO has initiated a temporary spend freeze while we close out the fiscal year and align budgets for FY27. That means we need to push any product evaluation activity until the early January planning window unless an exception is approved.

Also, a couple of key stakeholders (including Tom) will be traveling the week of Nov 22–29 for client conferences, so the dates you proposed won't work for us.

Can we tentatively target the week of Jan 11–15? I'd prefer Jan 12 or 13 if possible. I'll loop in procurement once we have a concrete proposal to track the paperwork.

Apologies for the delay — I know timing is tight on your end. Please let me know if you want to keep a placeholder in December as a backup.

Thanks,
